title: Playlist Assignment State
description: The result of assigning the video to a configured playlist via playlistItems.insert, or a clean skip when no playlist is configured — mark_playlist_applied()'s persisted fact. Never creates a playlist. See docs/architecture/youtube-publication-pipeline.md#playlist-assignment.

skipped.description: true when no playlist was configured for this channel/project — a clean no-op, not a failure.
